Path 3, fleetGOALS §5.1

Cluster API

Clusters themselves as declarative, reconciled objects.

WHAT IT IS

A SIG Cluster Lifecycle project with providers for AWS, vSphere, Nutanix and more, managing create, upgrade and delete of clusters through Kubernetes resources.

WHAT SETS IT APART

One lifecycle model across on-prem and EKS, which is the answer to our hybrid shape. Versus eksctl and Terraform: reconciliation instead of a one-shot apply.

WHERE WE STAND

The lifecycle half of fleet management, next to Auto Mode on EKS; automated fleet upgrades hang off it.

Cluster API maintainer track; Mirantis, Nutanix, Ericsson and Microsoft talks, KubeCon NA 2026

ADOPT

Cluster API: Clusters themselves as declarative, reconciled objects. Where we stand: The lifecycle half of fleet management, next to Auto Mode on EKS; automated fleet upgrades hang off it. Delivery with ApplicationSets plus lifecycle with Cluster API is the whole answer to fleet toil.
